posts.text:
Satellites caught Terafab's land clearing a month before the first news report.

Sentinel-2, Grimes County TX:
• Jun 29 — forest
• Jul 9 — first cleared strip
• Jul 31 — ~155 acres
• Sep 22 — ~520 acres

First press report: Aug 11.
Weekly satellite frames + filings for every Musk site → gigascope.xyz/site/terafab-grimes
